result.summary: Independent read-only acceptance review of the uncommitted CLM-018 reuse-rights implementation. Verdict: ACCEPT_WITH_NONBLOCKING_NOTES — every named surface (footer, about, licensing, terms, metadata, downloads, API docs, embeds, citation UI, CITATION.cff) distinguishes free access from reuse rights, every reuse claim resolves to the canonical interim registry (/licensing#reuse ← src/lib/claims/reuse-rights.ts), no required surface carries a false blanket-open or code-license claim, the negation-aware scanner fails closed and is wired into npm run build via the claims-docs aggregate gate, the Dataset JSON-LD contract cannot emit isAccessibleForFree without conditionsOfAccess + the canonical rights URL, and the medium embed's 'Reuse: civicaatlas.org/licensing' pointer renders in-frame at 320x180. No blocking findings; four cosmetic/robustness nonblocking notes. DAT-003 and BRD-007/008 remain honestly deferred.
commands_run: git diff (embed route, widget, metadata, terms, about, footer, CiteAccordion, api-docs, CITATION, README, blog, public-claims, CSS, AGENTS)
grep sweeps for residual open-source/MIT/open-data/blanket-open language across src, content, README, CITATION
grep isAccessibleForFree emitters and buildDataset callers
grep home-stat mark rendering (HomeGrid.tsx) and validate-claims-docs.ts manifest spawn wiring
result.verification: validate:rights-claims PASS (all 10 required surfaces carry a pointer; registry rows clean; CODE_RIGHTS.hasLicenseFile=false cross-checked vs absent root LICENSE; 5 licensing markers present). reuse-rights.test.ts 23/23. metadata-contract.test.ts 56/56. validate:metadata PASS. Confirmed validate-claims-docs.ts iterates CLAIMS_DOCS_GATE_MANIFEST.checks and spawns npm run validate:rights-claims (category terminology-policy), with seeded fail-closed fixtures pre-flight, and npm run build runs the aggregate. Scanner negation window bounded to 48 chars — distant negations cannot launder a later overclaim. Browser evidence embed-medium.png confirms the reuse pointer is visible/not clipped in the 320x180 frame.
result.next_action: Accept and commit CLM-018. Optionally fold the four nonblocking notes (symbol-name pointer acceptance in hasRightsPointer, literal-only blanket-open matching, stale 'Open data' comment in home.css:106, retained blog heading 'Why Open Data Matters') into a later cleanup. Keep DAT-003 (complete manifest) and BRD-007/008 (code license) explicitly deferred; they are out of scope and not grounds for change here.
